def ByteArray.lt (a b : ByteArray) : Bool := let rec (i : Nat) : Bool := if i < a.size && i < b.size then if a[i]! < b[i]! then true else if a[i]! > b[i]! then false else rec (i + 1) else a.size < b.size rec 0

instance : LT ByteArray where lt := ByteArray.lt

instance : Ord ByteArray where compare a b := if ByteArray.lt a b then .lt else if ByteArray.lt b a then .gt else .eq

instance : DecidableRel (fun a b : ByteArray => a < b) := fun a b => match compare a b with | .lt => isTrue (by decide) | _ => isFalse (by decide)

def MemoryBlock.updateAccessTime (self : MemoryBlock) (time : Int) : MemoryBlock := { self with access_count := self.access_count + 1, last_access_time := time }

def MemoryBlock.hasEntanglement (self : MemoryBlock) (other : ByteArray) : Bool := self.entangled_blocks.contains other

def MemoryBlock.entangledCount (self : MemoryBlock) : Nat := self.entangled_blocks.size

def MemoryBlock.clone (self : MemoryBlock) (allocator : Allocator) : MemoryBlock := { self with entangled_blocks := self.entangled_blocks }

def writeU64Little (out : ByteArray) (v : Nat) : ByteArray := let rec (i : Nat) (x : Nat) (arr : ByteArray) : ByteArray := if i < out.size then let b := (x &&& 0xFF).toUInt8 rec (i + 1) (x >>> 8) (arr.set! i b) else arr termination_by out.size - i decreasing_by simp_wf apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt assumption rec 0 v out

def writeI128Little (out : ByteArray) (v : Int) : ByteArray := let ux := v.toNat.toUInt128 let rec (i : Nat) (x : UInt128) (arr : ByteArray) : ByteArray := if i < out.size then let b := x.toUInt8 rec (i + 1) (x >>> 8) (arr.set! i b) else arr termination_by out.size - i decreasing_by simp_wf apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt assumption rec 0 ux out

def sha256_rotateRight (x : UInt64) (n : Nat) : UInt64 := let n' := n % 64 (x >>> n') ||| (x <<< (64 - n'))

def sha256_ch (x y z : UInt64) : UInt64 := (x &&& y) ^^^ (~x &&& z) def sha256_maj (x y z : UInt64) : UInt64 := (x &&& y) ^^^ (x &&& z) ^^^ (y &&& z) def sha256_sigma0 (x : UInt64) : UInt64 := sha256_rotateRight x 2 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 13 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 22 def sha256_sigma1 (x : UInt64) : UInt64 := sha256_rotateRight x 6 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 11 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 25 def sha256_gamma0 (x : UInt64) : UInt64 := sha256_rotateRight x 7 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 18 ^^^ (x >>> 3) def sha256_gamma1 (x : UInt64) : UInt64 := sha256_rotateRight x 17 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 19 ^^^ (x >>> 10)

def sha256_prepare_w (chunk : Array UInt64) : Array UInt64 := let mut w := Array.mkArray 64 (0:UInt64) for i in [:16] do w := w.set! i chunk[i]! let mut j := 16 while j < 64 do let s0 := sha256_gamma0 (w[j-3]!) let s1 := sha256_gamma1 (w[j-8]!) let val := (w[j-16]! + s0 + w[j-7]! + s1).toUInt64 w := w.set! j val j := j + 1 termination_by 64 - j decreasing_by simp_wf apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt assumption w

def sha256_transform (state : Array UInt64) (chunk : Array UInt64) : Array UInt64 := let w := sha256_prepare_w chunk let rec (i : Nat) (a b c d e f g h : UInt64) : UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 := if i < 64 then let s1 := sha256_sigma1 e let ch := sha256_ch e f g let temp1 := h + s1 + ch + (sha256_k i).toUInt64 + w[i]! let s0 := sha256_sigma0 a let maj := sha256_maj a b c let temp2 := s0 + maj rec (i + 1) (temp1 + temp2) a b c d (d + temp1) e f else (a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h) termination_by 64 - i decreasing_by simp_wf apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt assumption let (na, nb, nc, nd, ne, nf, ng, nh) := rec 0 state[0]! state[1]! state[2]! state[3]! state[4]! state[5]! state[6]! state[7]! #[na + state[0]!, nb + state[1]!, nc + state[2]!, nd + state[3]!, ne + state[4]!, nf + state[5]!, ng + state[6]!, nh + state[7]!]

(padded_len - 8) ((ml >>> 56).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8 padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 7) ((ml >>> 48).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8 padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 6) ((ml >>> 40).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8 padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 5) ((ml >>> 32).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8 padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 4) ((ml >>> 24).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8 padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 3) ((ml >>> 16).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8 padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 2) ((ml >>> 8).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8 padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 1) ((ml >>> 0).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8

let rec (i : Nat) (st : Array UInt64) : Array UInt64 := if i < padded_len / 64 then let chunk := Array.mkArray 16 (0:UInt64) let mut c' := chunk for j in [:16] do let idx := i * 64 + j * 4 let v := (padded[idx]!.toUInt64 <<< 24) ||| (padded[idx+1]!.toUInt64 <<< 16) ||| (padded[idx+2]!.toUInt64 <<< 8) ||| padded[idx+3]!.toUInt64 c' := c'.set! j v let st' := sha256_transform st c' rec (i + 1) st' else st termination_by (padded_len / 64) - i decreasing_by simp_wf apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt assumption

def computeContentHash (data : ByteArray) : ByteArray := let full := sha256 data let res := ByteArray.mk (List.replicate CONTENT_HASH_SIZE 0) let rec (i : Nat) (acc : ByteArray) : ByteArray := if i < CONTENT_HASH_SIZE then rec (i + 1) (acc.set! i full[i]!) else acc termination_by CONTENT_HASH_SIZE - i decreasing_by simp_wf apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt assumption rec 0 res

def computeBlockId (content_hash : ByteArray) (timestamp : Int) : ByteArray := let buffer := ByteArray.mk (List.replicate (CONTENT_HASH_SIZE + 16) 0) let rec1 (i : Nat) (acc : ByteArray) : ByteArray := if i < CONTENT_HASH_SIZE then rec1 (i + 1) (acc.set! i content_hash[i]!) else acc termination_by CONTENT_HASH_SIZE - i decreasing_by simp_wf apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt assumption let buffer := rec1 0 buffer let buffer := writeI128Little buffer timestamp let hash_out := sha256 buffer let res := ByteArray.mk (List.replicate BLOCK_ID_SIZE 0) let rec2 (i : Nat) (acc : ByteArray) : ByteArray := if i < BLOCK_ID_SIZE then rec2 (i + 1) (acc.set! i hash_out[i]!) else acc termination_by BLOCK_ID_SIZE - i decreasing_by simp_wf apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt assumption rec2 0 res

structure ContentAddressableStorage where storage : StorageMap content_index : ContentIndex affinity_map : AffinityMap total_capacity : Nat used_capacity : Nat deriving Repr

def ContentAddressableStorage.init (allocator : Allocator) (cap : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage := { storage := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b) content_index := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b) affinity_map := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b) total_capacity := cap used_capacity := 0 }

def unlinkEntanglements (storage : StorageMap) (block_id : ByteArray) (entangled : BlockIdSet) : StorageMap := let rec (iter : BlockIdSet) (acc : StorageMap) : StorageMap := if iter.isEmpty then acc else let other_id := iter.getMin!.1 let acc' := match acc.find? other_id with | some block => let new_block := block.removeEntangledBlock block_id let final_block := if new_block.entangledCount == 0 && new_block.state == .entangled then { new_block with state := .allocated } else new_block acc.insert other_id final_block | none => acc rec (iter.erase other_id) acc' termination_by iter.size decreasing_by simp_wf apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt apply BlockIdSet.size_erase simp intro h rw [h] contradiction rec entangled storage

def ContentAddressableStorage.retrieve (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (block_id : ByteArray) (time : Int) : Option (ByteArray × ContentAddressableStorage) := match self.storage.find? block_id with | some block => let updated_block := block.updateAccessTime time let new_storage := self.storage.insert block_id updated_block some (block.data, { self with storage := new_storage }) | none => none

def ContentAddressableStorage.entangleBlocks (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (block_id1 : ByteArray) (block_id2 : ByteArray) : ContentAddressableStorage := let block1 := self.storage.find? block_id1 let block2 := self.storage.find? block_id2 match block1, block2 with | some b1, some b2 => if block_id1 == block_id2 then self else let nb1 := b1.addEntangledBlock block_id2 let nb2 := b2.addEntangledBlock block_id1 let sb1 := { nb1 with state := .entangled } let sb2 := { nb2 with state := .entangled } let s' := self.storage.insert block_id1 sb1 |>.insert block_id2 sb2 { self with storage := s' } | _, _ => self

structure TaskDescriptor where task_id : ByteArray priority : Int data_dependencies : List ByteArray estimated_cycles : Nat assigned_core : Option Nat completion_status : Bool start_time : Int end_time : Int deriving Repr

def TaskDescriptor.init (allocator : Allocator) (task_id : ByteArray) (priority : Int) (est : Nat) : TaskDescriptor := { task_id := task_id priority := priority data_dependencies := [] estimated_cycles := est assigned_core := none completion_status := false start_time := 0 end_time := 0 }

def TaskDescriptor.addDependency (self : TaskDescriptor) (allocator : Allocator) (dep : ByteArray) : TaskDescriptor := { self with data_dependencies := self.data_dependencies ++ [dep] }

def TaskDescriptor.getDuration (self : TaskDescriptor) : Int := if self.completion_status && self.end_time > self.start_time then self.end_time - self.start_time else 0

def compareTasks (a b : TaskDescriptor) : Bool := a.priority > b.priority || (a.priority == b.priority && compare a.task_id b.task_id == .lt)

structure DynamicTaskScheduler where pending_tasks : List TaskDescriptor active_tasks : Std.RBMap ByteArray TaskDescriptor (fun a b => a < b) completed_tasks : List TaskDescriptor task_counter : Nat deriving Repr

def DynamicTaskScheduler.init (allocator : Allocator) : DynamicTaskScheduler := { pending_tasks := [] active_tasks := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b) completed_tasks := [] task_counter := 0 }
